name: Baked Pork Chops
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 3–4 bone-in pork chops, ¼ inch (6 mm) thin
1 medium apple, cored and sliced thin
1 tbsp (15 ml) caraway seed (can be salvaged from the bag your rye bread comes in)
Garlic salt, black pepper, and Dijon mustard, to taste

steps: Layer sliced onion and apple in a baking dish that can be covered; drizzle honey and half the caraway over apple and onion slices
Season meat with garlic salt and pepper; spread top of meat with Dijon
Cover and bake for one hour.
